latest_release.name: rclone v1.76.0
latest_release.body:
This is the v1.76.0 release of rclone.

Full details of the changes can be found in [the changelog](https://rclone.org/changelog/#v1-76-0-2026-11-06).

hot_issues.title: support for baidu pan (1 TB free)
Feature request: Listen filesystem events and sync
Microsoft Office apps can't write on an S3 mount when mounted with nfsmount on MacOS 14.5
vfs: add ability to exclude files from being uploaded (eg for temporary files)
